entry.title: I: Purposes and Definitions of Rhetoric
entry.summary: Book I of Aristotle's Rhetoric — its purposes, the three species of rhetoric, and the topics orators build arguments from, across 15 chapters.
entry.content:
Book I lays the groundwork for the rest of the work: what rhetoric is for, how it relates to dialectic, and the three species an orator works in (deliberative, forensic, and epideictic). It then works through the subject-matter each species draws on — the good, happiness, virtue, the forms of government, and the workings of praise, accusation, and legal judgment — before closing with the mechanics of a trial.
